items.target: ばしょをおしえてください
じゅうしょをかいてください

items.english: Smith-san wrote a report after the meeting.

items.target: あしたかいぎでプレゼンをします
items.english: I'm going to give a presentation at the meeting tomorrow.

items.target: うちにきて、ひるごはんをたべませんか
items.english: Shall we have lunch at my place? (Come over and eat lunch.)
items.note: きて (kite) is the て-form of きます (kimasu), an Irregular verb.

items.target: なかむらさんにでんわばんごうをきいてください
items.english: Please ask Nakamura-san for his telephone number.
items.note: Contrast pair with おんがくをきいてください (ongaku o kiite kudasai). Same て-form, but きいて (kiite) means "ask" when a person is marked with に (ni) and "listen" when the object is something you hear.

items.target: はこねにいって、テニスをします
items.english: I'll go to Hakone and play tennis.
items.scene: Someone asks what you are going to do tomorrow.
items.note: いって (itte) is the て-form of いきます (ikimasu), a Regular 1 verb.

items.target: でんわばんごうをおしえてください
items.english: Please tell me your telephone number.

items.target: ラジオでニュースをきいてください
items.english: Please listen to the news on the radio.
items.note: Contrast pair with なかむらさんにでんわばんごうをきいてください (Nakamura-san ni denwa bangō o kiite kudasai). Only the object and particle change, but the meaning of きいて (kiite) does.

items.target: レストランでひるごはんをたべて、びじゅつかんにいきます
items.english: I'll eat lunch at a restaurant and then go to the art museum.

items.target: チケットをかってください
あしたはよろしいですか
items.note: Minimal pair with いまよろしいですか (ima yoroshii desu ka): いま (ima) becomes あしたは (ashita wa).

items.target: かさをかしてください
くるまをかりて、ドライブをしました
items.english: I rented a car and went for a drive.
items.scene: Answering: What did you do yesterday?
items.note: かりて (karite) is the て-form of かります (karimasu), a Regular 2 verb: just change ます (masu) to て (te).

items.target: かいぎのあとでたべます
items.scene: A coworker asks when you plan to eat supper on a day you have an evening meeting.
items.note: あとで (ato de) after かいぎの (kaigi no) stresses that eating comes after the meeting. Compare まえに (mae ni) "Before" for the opposite order.

items.target: じゃ、こうべにいって、こうべビーフをたべませんか
items.english: Well then, how about going to Kobe and having some Kobe beef?

items.target: うけつけでまってください
items.english: Please wait at the reception desk.

items.target: ごご1じからかいぎがあります。かいぎのあと、レポートをかきます
items.english: There is a meeting from 1:00 p.m. After the meeting, I will write a report.

items.target: いまよろしいですか
items.note: Minimal pair with あしたはよろしいですか (ashita wa yoroshii desu ka): only the time word changes.

items.target: スミスさんはもくようびにおおさかにいって、かいぎをします。かいぎのあと、グリーンさんにでんわをします
items.english: On Thursday, Smith-san will go to Osaka and have a meeting. After the meeting, he will telephone Green-san.
items.note: いって (itte) is the て-form of いきます (ikimasu), a Regular 1 verb.

items.note: いって (itte) is the て-form of いきます (ikimasu), a Regular 1 verb. It links two actions with the same subject.
